forum.title: STM32 with at least 4x SPI and 2x USB
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @DZ888 and welcome to the ST community,

You can use [STM32 Cube finder](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/st-mcu-finder-pc.html) tool or [CubeMx tool](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html) then you fine tune the selection with the datasheet.

For example: STM32F429 has 5 SPIs and two USB interfaces: USB\_OTG\_FS (Full speed) and USB\_OTG\_HS (High speed):

![screenshot.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/54d636a9-4a71-18bb-ffe0-7208e3bd8fb9.png "screenshot.png")

STM32F746 has 6xSPIs and two USB interfaces: USB\_OTG\_FS (Full speed) and USB\_OTG\_HS (High speed):

![screenshot.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/37405cbc-1842-7607-2935-84495f7893f9.png "screenshot.png")

You need take care about the chip price and the performance you need in your application.
forum.content_text:
Dear STMicroelectronics Team,

I am looking for an STM32 microcontroller for a new project. My main requirements are:

* At least 4 SPI interfaces

* At least 2 USB interfaces

Could you please suggest suitable STM32 part numbers that meet or come close to these requirements?

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

DZ
